assets.name: Intro: Chest Flies On The Machine (45-Degree Angle)
assets.line: Chest flies are far superior to bench press for building your chest. Here's how to do them
assets.note: Opens on about 4 s of correct reps (first-5-seconds rule: exercise how-to opens on the exercise). Window, not full screen: a 9:16 crop cuts his hands off at the stretch. B0666 0.30-4.40 s, camera steady (moves at 4.44).

graphics.line: For your sets, do one easy warm-up set of 10 to 15 reps. Then do two working sets of 8 to 12 reps. Every working rep should be strict.
